## Literature

- Berryman, J. and Ziegler, A. (2024) *Prompt engineering for LLMs: The
  art and science of building large language model–based applications.*
  Sebastopol, CA: O'Reilly Media.
- Grimmer, J., Roberts, M.E. and Stewart, B.M. (2022) *Text as data: A
  new framework for machine learning and the social sciences.*
  Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press.

## R packages used in this course

- [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org/) — data wrangling
- [quanteda](https://quanteda.io/) — corpus, tokens, DFM, tf-idf
- [quanteda.textmodels](https://cran.r-project.org/package=quanteda.textmodels) — Naive Bayes and other text models
- [quanteda.textstats](https://cran.r-project.org/package=quanteda.textstats) / [quanteda.textplots](https://cran.r-project.org/package=quanteda.textplots) — descriptive stats & plots
- [WikipediR](https://cran.r-project.org/package=WikipediR) / [wikkitidy](https://cran.r-project.org/package=wikkitidy) — Wikipedia API wrappers
- [httr2](https://httr2.r-lib.org/) — HTTP requests / custom API calls
- [rollama](https://jbgruber.github.io/rollama/) — talk to local LLMs via [Ollama](https://ollama.com/)
